name: AL-LAD
effectsSummary: FreeODwiki says users generally consider AL-LAD more recreational and less threatening than LSD, but stresses it is a potent psychedelic and recommends appropriate precautions and harm reduction. The effects index is based on anecdotal reports and may be unpredictable.
dosageRemark: The archived oral table lists threshold 20 µg, light 50-100 µg, moderate 100-225 µg, strong 225-350 µg, heavy 350 µg+; total duration 7-10 h, onset 20-60 min, comeup 30-60 min, peak 2.5-5 h, offset 2-3 h and afterglow 2-18 h. Educational user/resource compilation, not a recommendation. The model has no separate threshold band, so 20 µg is preserved here and lightMin is the lower bound of the source light band.
generalRisks: FreeODwiki says pharmacological, metabolic and toxicity data for AL-LAD are very limited. Despite users commonly considering it more recreational and less threatening than LSD, it is a potent psychedelic and appropriate precautions are strongly recommended.
saferUse: FreeODwiki strongly recommends precautions and harm reduction for this potent psychedelic.
Effects are based on anecdotal reports, may be unpredictable, and adverse effects become more likely at higher doses.
summary: AL-LAD is a potent lysergamide psychedelic. FreeODwiki describes it as commonly viewed by users as more recreational and less threatening than LSD, while emphasizing sparse safety data and harm reduction.
